title: verbena porrigens var. paulsenii
intro: Verbena porrigens var. paulsenii, commonly known as Paul's Verbena, is a plant species within the verbena family, known for its fragrant, white flowers and essential oils. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality, due to its calming effects and sedative properties. The health benefits of Paul's Verbena include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against infections, reduce inflammation, and combat oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, including linalool, limonene, and geraniol, which have been identified as the primary bioactive compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
